# LinkNodes — full page and API map

Source: https://www.linknodes.io/llms-full.txt
Site: https://www.linknodes.io
OpenAPI: https://www.linknodes.io/v1/openapi.json
Agent card: https://www.linknodes.io/.well-known/agent.json

LinkNodes is a free, un-gated web toolkit for Chainlink developers. The frontend is a static React app. The backend is a stateless FastAPI process. There is no account system and no write API. Rate limit: 120 requests / 60 seconds / IP on `/v1/*`.

This document describes LinkNodes pages and public API routes. It is not the Chainlink for Agents gateway. Paid agent workflows live at https://agents.chain.link.

## Pages

### /
Marketing homepage. Product cards for Data Feeds, CCIP, Functions, VRF, and Automation. CTAs to the live sandboxes, the RWA hub, and the Agents page.

### /products/data-feeds
Live Data Feeds sandbox. Query 1,400+ feeds across 13 mainnets (and testnets via the header toggle). Historical `round_id` support. Production snippets. Uses GET /v1/registry, /v1/query/{chain}/{feed}, /v1/compare/{feed}.

### /products/ccip
CCIP explorer. Source/destination selectors, router addresses, RMN proxies, Solidity ccipSend snippets. Per-lane URLs at /products/ccip/{source}/{dest}. Uses GET /v1/ccip/registry and /v1/ccip/lane/{source}/{dest}.

### /products/functions, /products/vrf, /products/automation
Preview / documentation pages. Disallowed in robots.txt until the sandboxes are live.

### /feeds, /feeds/{chain}, /feeds/{chain}/{feed}
Feed catalog and per-feed pages with proxy addresses, heartbeats, and a live latest-round read.

### /rwa
Real-world asset hub: on-chain equity/commodity/tokenized feeds plus the list of 24/7 Data Streams. Session badges are calculated by LinkNodes from the NYSE calendar, not an oracle value.

### /chainlink-247
Reference article for the October 2026 Chainlink 24/7 launch. Feeds vs Streams, what is live, what is not.

### /agents
Chainlink for Agents (beta) explainer: skill install (`npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-for-agents`), Base wallet + USDC funding, registration, chain-wallet deploy, owner-set guardrails at app.chain.link, and the x402 402-then-retry flow. Includes a live table of the gateway catalog served from GET /v1/agents/catalog.

### /operators
Curated node-operator directory from GET /v1/operators.

### /sandbox
Legacy alias used in some docs; the live Data Feeds UI is /products/data-feeds.

## Public API

Base URL in production: https://www.linknodes.io
Local backend: http://localhost:8100
CORS: allow all origins. No authentication.

### GET /v1/openapi.json
OpenAPI 3 document for this API. FastAPI's default `/openapi.json` is intentionally unused because the public hostname only proxies `/v1/*` and `/healthz`.

### GET /v1/docs
Swagger UI for the same spec.

### GET /v1/registry?environment=mainnet|testnet
Full Data Feeds catalog. Shut-down feeds are filtered at request time. Gzip-compressed.

### GET /v1/query/{network}/{feed}?round_id=&environment=
Live `latestRoundData()` or historical `getRoundData()`. `{network}` is a slug such as `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `base`. `{feed}` is a slug such as `eth-usd`, `xau-usd`.

### GET /v1/compare/{feed}?environment=
Same feed on every chain it is deployed on, plus min/max/spread_bps.

### GET /v1/ccip/registry?environment=mainnet|testnet
CCIP routers, chain selectors, RMN proxies, supported destinations.

### GET /v1/ccip/lane/{source}/{destination}?environment=
One lane. 404 if the pair is unknown or not supported.

### GET /v1/streams-247
List-only catalog of Chainlink 24/7 Data Streams (feed IDs, no live report prices).

### GET /v1/operators
Curated marketing-style operator directory.

### GET /v1/agents/catalog
Cached copy of https://agents.chain.link/v1/catalog plus unpaid per-item detail (`kind`, `execute_endpoint`, `price_usdc` when published). Refreshed by the daily GitHub data-refresh workflow. The running API also retries the gateway every 30 minutes and keeps the last good copy if the gateway is down.

### GET /healthz
Liveness plus catalog counts. Not rate limited.

### POST /mcp
Optional Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint mounted on the existing backend (no extra host). Same read-only tools as `packages/linknodes-mcp`. Prefer the stdio package on your own machine until production proxies `/mcp` the same way it already proxies `/v1`.

## MCP (stdio)

`packages/linknodes-mcp` is a read-only stdio MCP server. It calls `https://www.linknodes.io/v1` with no API key. The owner publishes it to npm; until then run `node packages/linknodes-mcp/src/index.js` from a clone. Tools: search_feeds, lookup_feed, compare_feed, ccip_registry, ccip_lane, list_streams_247, list_operators, agents_catalog.
